title: A column returned by VALUES keeps its lineage and filters the model in context transition

source.quote: What really matters is only the data lineage of a column, which is the original column the values have been retrieved from
source.supports: a column filters the model through its lineage, the model column its values come from

derivation: Red is products 1 and 2: Sales rows 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 = 100 + 40 + 20 + 200 + 100 = 460. Blue is product 3: rows 4, 6 = 50 + 30 = 80. Green is product 4, with no sales: BLANK. ADDCOLUMNS keeps the row.
